mainTopic: The night watch of the כהנים in the בית המקדש: where they guarded, where they slept, and what a כהן did if he became טמא at night
overview: This opening משנה of מסכת תמיד describes the nighttime setup in the בית המקדש. The כהנים kept watch in three rooms: בית אבטינס, בית הניצוץ and בית המוקד. בית אבטינס and בית הניצוץ had upper stories, and the רובים, young כהנים not yet old enough to serve, guarded up there. בית המוקד was a large domed room with stone ledges along its walls. The elders of the בית אב serving the next day slept there and held the keys to the עזרה. The פרחי כהונה slept on the floor. They took off their בגדי קודש, put them under their heads, and covered themselves with their own clothes. Finally the משנה begins describing what a כהן did if he had a קרי during the night, and that description continues on the next amud.

steps.title: The three guard posts in the Temple
steps.stepSummary: The משנה lists three rooms where the כהנים kept watch. It adds that two of them had upper stories where the young ones guarded.
steps.simpleTranslation: The כהנים kept watch in three places in the בית המקדש: בית אבטינס, בית הניצוץ and בית המוקד. בית אבטינס and בית הניצוץ had upper stories, and the young ones kept watch there.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה opens the מסכת by telling us that the כהנים guarded the בית המקדש at night, and where they did it.
steps.deeperAnalysis: There are three guard posts. Two of them, בית אבטינס and בית הניצוץ, had a second floor, and the רובים (the youngsters) stood guard up there. The third room, בית המוקד, will be described separately in the next step.

keyTerms.meaning: Our משנה; the text being studied
The room named after the אבטינס family, who prepared the קטורת
The Chamber of the Hearth, a room with a fire
Young boys or youths; here, young כהנים

phrases.english: MISHNA: In three places
the priests keep watch in the Temple:
the Chamber of Avtinas,
phrases.notes: This is the room where the incense, the קטורת, was prepared.

phrases.english: the Chamber of the Spark, and the Chamber of the Hearth.
In the Chamber of Avtinas and in the Chamber of the Spark
there were upper stories,
and the young ones keep watch there.
phrases.notes: רובים means youngsters, young כהנים who were not yet old enough to do the עבודה.

steps.triggerLanguage: בִּשְׁלֹשָׁה מְקוֹמוֹת הַכֹּהֲנִים שׁוֹמְרִים בְּבֵית הַמִּקְדָּשׁ
steps.mimraCoreRuling: The כהנים guard in three places: בית אבטינס, בית הניצוץ and בית המוקד. The young ones guard in the upper stories of the first two.

steps.title: Description of the Chamber of the Hearth and the elders who slept there
steps.stepSummary: The משנה describes בית המוקד as a large domed room ringed with stone ledges. The elders of the בית אב slept there and held the keys to the עזרה.
steps.simpleTranslation: בית המוקד had a dome and was a large room, surrounded by ledges of stone. The elders of the בית אב slept there, and the keys of the עזרה were in their hands.
steps.whatsHappening: Now the משנה turns to the third guard post, בית המוקד, and explains how it was built and who slept there.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Because בית המוקד had a dome, it had no upper story, unlike the first two rooms. Stone ledges ran around its walls. The senior כהנים of the family on duty slept there and were trusted with the keys to the עזרה.

keyTerms.meaning: Rows or ledges of stone along the walls
The elders of the priestly family group that would serve the next day
The courtyard of the בית המקדש

phrases.english: The Chamber of the Hearth was a dome,
and it was a large building,
surrounded by rows of stone.
phrases.notes: These were stone ledges sticking out from the walls, and they served as benches.

phrases.english: The elders of the family group would sleep there
and the keys of the courtyard were in their hands.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Expands on the third guard post listed in step 1
steps.mimraCoreRuling: The elders of the בית אב slept in the domed בית המוקד and held the keys to the עזרה.

steps.title: How the young priests slept
steps.stepSummary: The פרחי כהונה slept on the floor. They took off their holy garments, put them under their heads, and covered themselves with their own clothes.
steps.simpleTranslation: The young כהנים each slept with his garment on the ground. They did not sleep in the holy garments. They took them off, put them under their heads, and covered themselves with their own clothing.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה now describes the young כהנים who also slept in בית המוקד, and how they handled their בגדי קודש at night.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Unlike the elders, the young כהנים did not use the stone benches. They slept on the floor. They never slept while wearing the בגדי קודש. Instead they took them off and kept them under their heads, and used their own regular clothes as blankets.

keyTerms.meaning: Literally 'blossoms of the priesthood'; young כהנים old enough to serve

steps.confusionAlert: Don't mix up the רובים from step 1, who were too young to serve and guarded upstairs, with the פרחי כהונה here, who were young men already old enough to serve.

phrases.english: The young men of the priesthood
each one with his garment on the ground.
They did not sleep in the holy garments,
rather, they would take them off and place them
beneath their heads,
and cover themselves with their own clothing.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Continues describing who slept in בית המוקד, moving from the elders to the young כהנים
steps.mimraCoreRuling: The young כהנים slept on the ground and not in the בגדי קודש. They placed the garments under their heads and covered themselves with their own clothes.

steps.title: A priest who became impure during the night leaves
steps.stepSummary: If one of the sleeping כהנים had a קרי, he would get up and leave. The משנה continues describing where he went after this section.
steps.simpleTranslation: If one of them had a seminal emission, he goes out and walks away...
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה starts a new case: a כהן who became טמא from קרי during the night. It tells us he left the room, and it is setting up a description of where he went, which continues in the next lines.
steps.deeperAnalysis: A קרי makes the כהן טמא, so he cannot stay in his place. The משנה tells us his first move: he gets up and leaves. The full route he takes comes right after this.

keyTerms.meaning: A seminal emission, which makes a person טמא
He goes out and walks off

phrases.english: If a seminal emission happened to one of them,
he goes out and walks away

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Moves from the normal sleeping routine to what happens when a sleeping כהן becomes טמא
steps.mimraCoreRuling: A כהן who has a קרי during the night leaves the room. The description of where he goes continues after this section.
